findings.title: Route is attached to a Gateway that does not exist
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop attaches to Gateway shop-gateway, which does not exist in namespace kd-gateway-parent-missing, so no Gateway serves the route and its requests get no answer from the cluster; the Gateways of namespace kd-gateway-parent-missing are public

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-parent-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.parentRefs}'

evidence.what: the Gateways of namespace kd-gateway-parent-missing are public

findings.fix: Correct the parentRef's name in HTTPRoute shop (and its namespace, for a Gateway in another namespace), or create the Gateway.
